passages.provision_quote: Athletic teams or sports designated for "females", "women" or "girls" may not be open to students of the male sex.
passages.note: Enacted text restricts girls' teams by biological sex while leaving boys' and coed teams open to all students, matching rung 4 and excluding rung 5.

rows.reasoning: Neal Carter voted Y on SB1165 (2022), a single-subject bill whose enacted text requires girls' and women's teams to be restricted to students of the female sex while expressly leaving boys' and coed teams open to all, matching rung 4's text 'require transgender athletes to compete only on teams matching their biological sex assigned at birth.' The 31-24 tally is not near-unanimous, and the vote falls within Carter's prior House term (2021-11-05 to 2023-01-09), so it is in-term for his current seat.
